info.name: OpenClaw Management API
info.description:
Management API for OpenClaw VPS service. Runs on port 9998.

Authentication: Bearer token (OPENCLAW_MGMT_API_KEY from .env)

Base URL: http://<VPS_IP>:9998

request.description: Get service info: domain, IP, dashboard URL, gateway token, status, version.
Get container status for OpenClaw and Caddy, including version and gateway port.
Get system info: hostname, IP, OS, uptime, CPU load, memory, disk usage, Docker/Node versions.
Get current domain configuration, SSL status, and Caddyfile content.

response.name: Success
response.body:
{
  "ok": true,
  "domain": "openclaw.example.com",
  "ip": "1.2.3.4",
  "ssl": true,
  "selfSignedSSL": false,
  "caddyfile": "openclaw.example.com {\n    tls {\n        issuer acme ...\n    }\n    reverse_proxy openclaw:18789\n}"
}

request.description:
Update domain and configure SSL via Let's Encrypt. DNS must point to server IP. Validates DNS before applying. Rolls back on failure.

Parameters:
- domain (required): Domain name
- email (optional): Email for Let's Encrypt notifications

response.name: DNS Error

request.description: Get current version, Docker image name, and image digest.
Pull latest Docker image and recreate container. Runs asynchronously (returns 202). Check /api/status for progress.
Restart the OpenClaw container.
Stop the OpenClaw container.
Start the OpenClaw container.
Full recreate: docker compose down + up -d. Recreates all containers.
DESTRUCTIVE: Delete all data + config, recreate from defaults. Requires {"confirm":"RESET"} in body. Keeps .env file (tokens preserved).

response.name: Success

query.description: Service name: openclaw or caddy (default: openclaw)

request.description: Get container logs. Supports query params: lines (1-1000), service (openclaw|caddy).
Get current config: provider, model, API keys (masked), agents/gateway/browser settings.

Change AI provider and model. Loads provider template config, injects gateway token, applies model override, restarts container.

Providers: anthropic, openai, gemini

Model parameter is optional — if omitted, uses provider's default model.

Update API key for a provider. Sets the key in .env and restarts the container.

Providers: anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), openai (OPENAI_API_KEY), gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY)

Test an API key before applying. Makes a real API call to the provider to verify the key is valid.

Providers: anthropic, openai, gemini
Get a flattened overview of the current OpenClaw config structure merged with provider template samples. Useful for building schema-aware UI controls and path pickers.
Inspect a single config path in the live config and in the merged schema/sample view. Sensitive values are masked.
Deep-merge a partial object into openclaw.json. Existing endpoints remain available; this adds a more flexible schema-aware update path.
Set one config value by dot-path. Supports nested objects and array indexes. Set `remove: true` to delete a path.
Apply persisted configuration and optionally restart `openclaw`, `caddy`, `all`, or `none`. Useful after batching multiple config edits.

response.name: Success

request.description: Read the raw `openclaw.json` file content plus basic file metadata. Useful for audits, export, or advanced troubleshooting.
List all messaging channels and their configuration status. Tokens are masked.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Add or update a messaging channel token. Restarts container after applying.

Channels: telegram, discord, slack, zalo

For Slack, you can also pass appToken in the body.

Remove a messaging channel. Deletes the token from .env and restarts container.

Channels: telegram, discord, slack, zalo

query.description: Ask the upstream gateway to actively probe channel connectivity

request.description: Fetch upstream-style channel status from the OpenClaw gateway, including live connectivity and richer account state when supported by the channel plugin.
Log out a channel session through the upstream gateway method `channels.logout`.
Install the Zalo plugin inside the OpenClaw container and enable the `zalo` plugin entry in local config. Supported specs: `@openclaw/zalo`, `./extensions/zalo`.
Return a Zalo-specific config snapshot, including plugin state, masked token sources, transport mode, pairing defaults, and Marketplace-bot capability notes.
Merge a local Zalo config patch, validate DM/webhook/media fields, enable the plugin entry, optionally sync `accounts.default.botToken` to `ZALO_BOT_TOKEN`, and restart the gateway by default.
Fetch a filtered upstream `channels.status` snapshot for only the `zalo` channel. Useful to verify token validity and live connectivity.
Show effective Zalo webhook visibility without exposing secrets. Includes mode, root/default-account webhook URL/path, and constraint hints.
List Zalo pairing state through the CLI wrapper `pairing list zalo --json`. DM access defaults to pairing for Marketplace bots.
Approve a pending Zalo pairing code through `pairing approve zalo <CODE>`.
Return a consolidated Zalo snapshot with local config state, filtered channel probe output, pairing summary, and operational guidance for Marketplace-bot deployments.
Convenience logout route that injects the channel name from the URL path.
Return the upstream gateway model catalog exposed by `models.list`.
Return the upstream tool catalog from `tools.catalog`, optionally scoped to an agent.
Return provider usage / quota status from the upstream `usage.status` method.
Return session cost and token usage summary from the upstream `usage.cost` method.
List available skills across workspace, managed, and extra skill roots for the selected agent. Includes source, required binaries, and per-skill config overrides.

response.name: Success

Get full details of a skill, including parsed frontmatter, metadata, and the raw SKILL.md content.
Update `skills.entries.<skillKey>` in `openclaw.json` with enabled state, API key, env overrides, and custom config fields.

body.name: Create Exec Approval Request
body.description: Create a live execution approval request via upstream `exec.approval.request`. The wrapper defaults `twoPhase` to `true` when omitted.

body.name: Wait Exec Approval Decision
body.description: Wait for or poll the final decision of an execution approval request via `exec.approval.waitDecision`. Approval state is held in gateway memory.

body.name: Resolve Exec Approval
body.description: Resolve a pending execution approval via `exec.approval.resolve`. Supported decisions are `allow-once`, `allow-always`, and `deny`.

Get all environment variables from .env file. Sensitive values (containing TOKEN, KEY, SECRET, PASSWORD) are masked.
Set an environment variable in .env. Key must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Cannot modify OPENCLAW_MGMT_API_KEY. Restart service for changes to take effect.

request.description: Remove an environment variable from .env. Protected keys (OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN, OPENCLAW_MGMT_API_KEY, OPENCLAW_VERSION, OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT) cannot be removed.

Execute an OpenClaw CLI command inside the container.

Runs: docker compose exec openclaw node dist/index.js <command>

Security: Characters ; & | ` $ ( ) { } are blocked.

Examples:
- models scan
- config get
- config set agents.defaults.model.primary anthropic/claude-sonnet-4
- channels list
- gateway status

Download latest Management API (server.js), docker-compose.yml, and config templates from GitHub. Restarts the Management API service after update.
